title: Coping and Resilience Skills
description: A Cozy well-being check-in. Reflect on how you cope with stress and adversity.
disclaimer: This Cozy well-being check-in is for personal reflection. It is not a diagnosis or a validated clinical screening tool. The result describes only your answers to these five questions. If you are concerned about your well-being, speak with a qualified professional. If you feel unsafe or need urgent help, contact local emergency services or use the app's crisis support resources.

scoring_rules.recommendation: These descriptive result bands are for personal reflection and do not measure clinical severity.

bands.label: More support may help
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest fewer experiences that support coping and resilience. Consider practising a coping strategy that helps you and asking trusted people for support. If you are concerned, consider speaking with a qualified professional.

bands.label: Building well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest some experiences that support coping and resilience, with room to build on them. Consider practising a coping strategy that helps you and asking trusted people for support.

bands.label: Good well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest regular experiences that support coping and resilience. Keep practising what helps you.

bands.label: Strong well-being
bands.recommendation: Your answers suggest frequent experiences that support coping and resilience. Continue the habits and connections that help you.

questions.question: When faced with a challenging situation, how often do you feel confident in your ability to handle it?
How often do you find ways to relax and de-stress during difficult times?
How often do you seek support from others when dealing with stress?
How often do you maintain a positive outlook despite setbacks?
How often do you learn from past experiences to improve your coping strategies?
